versions.changelog:
diary-force 2.0.0 - Major update with full workflow upgrade and commercial support

- Rebuilt following skill-creator 2.0 standards, including a comprehensive new SKILL.md.
- Added daily 23:00 auto-reminder to enforce diary writing, with detection and interactive logging.
- Integrated 6 structured thinking models for deep diary analysis and optional cognitive internalization.
- Automated memory extraction and Git versioning for traceable growth.
- Introduced commercial options (SkillPay) with flexible pricing and usage scenarios.
- Detailed configuration, workflow, and user guidance added for easier adoption.
